notes.title: Try Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era On Steam Demo Festival
notes.content:
Hello,

We just released a demo for our next game "Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era" on Steam Next Festival.

Create weapons of your dreams from gunpowder pistols to grenade launchers. Craft cartridges by mixing powder ingredients. Melt ore, blow glass, study chemistry, and make explosives. Cut, mine, dig, shoot, build, research, design, craft, explore and more in the Dune deserts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426870/Dune_Mechanic__Survive_The_Steampunk_Era/

Cheers!

notes.title: Fantasy Blacksmith DLC Escape From The Forge This Friday on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Enjoy 4 new locations, teleportation, new resources, and ores for mining.
[/h1]

[b]This DLC features:[/b]

[list]
[*] portal which can be placed in the forge and can be used for teleportation to the outside world.
[*] 4 stones available in store, which transports the character to different locations.
[*] 4 new locations: Graveyard, Forest, Mines, and Cave.
[*] search and mine rare resources in the new locations.
[*] 2 new ores, which can be mined in certain locations.
[*] the book with all in-game items and the locations where you can find them.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591070/Fantasy_Blacksmith__Escape_From_The_Forge/
